findings.claim: Out-of-scope change creates a security hole. `MessagePackSecurity.GetEqualityComparer<T>` used to throw `TypeAccessException` for types that have no hash-collision-resistant comparer. It now silently returns `EqualityComparer<T>.Default`. Under `MessagePackSecurity.UntrustedData`, deserializing a dictionary or hash set keyed by an arbitrary type therefore uses a non-resistant comparer, which re-opens the hash-flooding DoS that this guard closed. REQ-2129 asks for nothing in this area, and the change contradicts the secure-by-default history recorded in L12.

receipt_plan.detail: In MessagePack.Tests, add `[Fact] public void UntrustedData_UnknownKeyType_Throws() => Assert.Throws<TypeAccessException>(() => MessagePackSecurity.UntrustedData.GetEqualityComparer<SomeUserClass>());` using a plain user class. It passes on base and fails on head because no exception is thrown.

findings.claim: The acceptance criterion 'If T does carry MessagePack attributes, they are honoured' is not met. `Collect` never looks at attributes on T. Without a surrogate it always calls `CreateContractlessMembers`, which takes every public read-write member, uses its name as a string key, and sorts ordinally. As a result, `[MessagePackObject]` with `[Key(int)]` keys is ignored and the wire format changes from an array to a map. `[IgnoreMember]` members are serialized. `[DataContract]`/`[DataMember]` membership and names are ignored, so non-`[DataMember]` public members are serialized. The maintainer note only allows contractless mode when T has no `[DataContract]` or `[MessagePackObject]`.

receipt_plan.detail: Run tests/MessagePack.SourceGenerator.Tests/Receipts/GeneratedFormatterHonoursTypeAttributesTests.cs. Both IgnoreMemberOnReferencedType_IsNotSerialized and DataContractOnReferencedType_LimitsMembers fail on head because the generated `partial class MyTypeFormatter` source references IgnoredSecretValue / NotADataMember.

findings.claim: The requirement says contractless behaviour over public members, but the generated formatter covers less than MessagePack's existing contractless mode. `IsPublicReadWrite` drops every get-only or init-less public property, so these members are silently not serialized at all, even on the serialize side. In addition, a class whose only constructor takes parameters (for example a positional record, common in dependency-free libraries) is rejected with MsgPack007 instead of matching constructor parameters by name as `ContractlessStandardResolver` does. Immutable public types from Project A therefore lose data or get no formatter.

receipt_plan.detail: In GeneratedFormatterCollector.cs, `CreateContractlessMembers` filters with `IsPublicReadWrite`, which requires a public setter (lines 135 and 275-282). The isClass check at line 77 returns null with `NoDeserializingConstructor` when there is no parameterless ctor, and `constructorParameters` is always empty. Compare with DynamicContractlessObjectResolver, which serializes get-only public properties and binds ctor parameters.

interpretations.label: A
interpretations.summary: This is what the change implements. 'Contractless behaviour over public members' means only public read-write instance properties and fields, keyed by name and sorted ordinally. A class needs an accessible parameterless constructor, otherwise MsgPack007 is reported. Get-only public properties are skipped entirely.

interpretations.label: B
interpretations.summary: 'Contractless behaviour' means the same semantics as the existing DynamicContractlessObjectResolver / ContractlessStandardResolver. Readable public properties and fields would be serialized even when get-only. On deserialization, constructor parameters would be matched to members by name, and settable members would be assigned. The minimal edit to the change: in `CreateContractlessMembers`, also include public members that have only a public getter, with `IsWritable: false`. Select the best public constructor whose parameters match member names and types, and pass those parameters as `constructorParameters`. Only report MsgPack007 when neither a parameterless constructor nor a matching constructor exists.
